source.title: PoinTr: Diverse Point Cloud Completion with Geometry-Aware Transformers

blocks.original_text: we present a new method that reformulates point cloud completion as a set-to-set translation problem
blocks.translation: 论文把点云补全重写为集合到集合的翻译问题。

blocks.original_text: we represent the point cloud as a set of unordered groups of points with position embeddings
blocks.translation: 模型把点云表示成带位置嵌入的无序点组集合。

blocks.original_text: Our final objective function is the sum of these two objectives J = J0 + J1.
blocks.translation: 最终目标函数是两个 Chamfer 目标之和。

blocks.original_text: The geometry-aware block introduces the inductive bias about 3D geometric structures.
blocks.translation: geometry-aware block 为 Transformer 引入三维几何结构归纳偏置。
